text: You lost the TV remote. You check under the sofa. Nothing. So you buy a metal detector. It finds a sword. And a pirate. The pirate says, dig deeper. So you dig. Through the floor. Through the Earth's core. You come out in the stone age. The cavemen think your phone is a god. A T-rex chases you all the way home. You finally sit down. The remote was in your hand.
